SIMRES.SCRIPT:
# load bi-spectral source set SOURCE FLUXTAB ESS2016_W2_thermal_5ms.tab XML SOURCE
# load bi-spectral source set SOURCE FLUXTAB ESS2016_W2_cold_5ms.tab XML SOURCE
# load bi-spectral source set SOURCE FLUXTAB ESS2016_W2_thermal_5ms.tab:ESS2016_W2_cold_5ms.tab XML SOURCE
# set MCC chopper slits set MCC TIMING 0:45:0.3125:1:0.375:1:0.4375:1:0.5:1:0.5625:1:0.625:1:0.6875:1 XML MCC
# set wavelength range 1 .. 3 #------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2 XML UPDATE set SOURCE LAMW 1.0 XML SOURCE
# set wavelength range 0.5 .. 6.5 #------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 3.5 XML UPDATE set SOURCE LAMW 1.7143 XML SOURCE
# set wavelength range 0.2 .. 8.2 #------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 4.2 XML UPDATE set SOURCE LAMW 1.9047 XML SOURCE
# set sample slit as needed #-------------------------------------- # open by default set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
# Set waviness and misalignment #-----------------------------------------------
set NBOA MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set BBG MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GSW MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA3 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA4 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCB MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCC MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCE MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCF MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCG MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GN1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GN2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GSH2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE2A MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE2B MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GT1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GT2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GF1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GF2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GEX1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02
set NBOA WAV 0.2 set BBG WAV 0.2 set GSW WAV 0.2 set GCA1 WAV 0.2 set GCA2 WAV 0.2 set GCA3 WAV 0.2 set GCA4 WAV 0.2 set GCB WAV 0.2 set GCC WAV 0.2 set GCE WAV 0.2 set GCF WAV 0.2 set GCG WAV 0.2 set GE1 WAV 0.2 set GN1 WAV 0.2 set GN2 WAV 0.2 set GSH2 WAV 0.2 set GE2A WAV 0.2 set GE2B WAV 0.2 set GT1 WAV 0.2 set GT2 WAV 0.2 set GF1 WAV 0.2 set GF2 WAV 0.2 set GEX1 WAV 0.2
#----------------------------------------------------------------- # WAVELENGTH SELECTION MODES #---------------------------------------------------------------- # NOTE: always start with mode 0 before executing the script for swicthing to another mode #
# To check for frame overlaps, set choppers like this: set FC2A OVERLAP 1 set FC2B OVERLAP 1 set FC1A OVERLAP 1 set FC1B OVERLAP 1 set PSC1 OVERLAP 1 set PSC2 OVERLAP 1 set PSC3 OVERLAP 1 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCB OVERLAP 1 set MCC OVERLAP 1
# To ignore frame overlaps and speed up simulation, set choppers like this: set FC2A OVERLAP 0 set FC2B OVERLAP 0 set FC1A OVERLAP 0 set FC1B OVERLAP 0 set PSC1 OVERLAP 0 set PSC2 OVERLAP 0 set PSC3 OVERLAP 0 set MCA OVERLAP 0 set MCB OVERLAP 0 set MCC OVERLAP 0
#------------------------------------------------------ # COLLIMATORS #------------------------------------------------------ # in RAD, load appropriate component RAD_xmm.rxcp, where x=collimation width. # Then set correct distances:
# 0.5 mm: set RAD DIST 100.0 XML RAD set DET DIST 1900.0 XML DET
# 1.0 mm: set RAD DIST 160.0 XML RAD set DET DIST 1840.0 XML DET
# 2.0 mm: set RAD DIST 310.0 XML RAD set DET DIST 1690.0 XML DET
# 4.0 mm: set RAD DIST 490.0 XML RAD set DET DIST 1510.0 XML DET
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- #---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # REFERENCE OPERATION MODES # Start with full open beam, F0, then use the setting below #---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- #----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# set waviness set NBOA WAV 0.2 set BBG WAV 0.2 set GSW WAV 0.2 set GCA1 WAV 0.2 set GCA2 WAV 0.2 set GCA3 WAV 0.2 set GCA4 WAV 0.2 set GCB WAV 0.2 set GCC WAV 0.2 set GCE WAV 0.2 set GCF WAV 0.2 set GCG WAV 0.2 set GE1 WAV 0.2 set GN1 WAV 0.2 set GN2 WAV 0.2 set GSH2 WAV 0.2 set GE2A WAV 0.2 set GE2B WAV 0.2 set GT1 WAV 0.2 set GT2 WAV 0.2 set GF1 WAV 0.2 set GF2 WAV 0.2 set GEX1 WAV 0.2
# set misalignment set NBOA MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set BBG MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GSW MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA3 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCA4 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCB MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCC MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCE MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCF MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GCG MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GN1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GN2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GSH2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE2A MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GE2B MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GT1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GT2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GF1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GF2 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02 set GEX1 MISALIGN 0.02 0.02
# To check for frame overlaps, set choppers like this: set FC2A OVERLAP 1 set FC2B OVERLAP 1 set FC1A OVERLAP 1 set FC1B OVERLAP 1 set PSC1 OVERLAP 1 set PSC2 OVERLAP 1 set PSC3 OVERLAP 1 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCB OVERLAP 1 set MCC OVERLAP 1
# disable multiple source pulses and set wide wavelength bandwidth set SOURCE OVERLAP 0 set SOURCE LAMW 6.0 XML SOURCE
#--------------------------------------------------- # mode F0, all choppers stopped #---------------------------------------------------- # FC1A off set FC1A FRQ 0.0 set FC1A TIMING 0:1 set FC1A T0 0 set FC1A LOCKT0 0 set FC1A ADJ 1 XML FC1A # FC1B off set FC1B FRQ 0.0 set FC1B TIMING 0:1 set FC1B T0 0 set FC1B LOCKT0 0 set FC1B ADJ 1 XML FC1B # FC2A off set FC2A ADJ 1 set FC2A PHASE 0.0 set FC2A FRQ 0.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 set FC2A T0 0 set FC2A LOCKT0 0 set FC2A ADJ 1 XML FC2A # FC2B off set FC2B FRQ 0.0 set FC2B TIMING 0:1 set FC2B T0 0 set FC2B LOCKT0 0 set FC2B ADJ 1 XML FC2B
# modulation A off set MCA FRQ 0 set MCA ADJ 1 set MCA T0 0 set MCA LOCKT0 0 XML MCA # modulation B off set MCB FRQ 0 set MCB ADJ 1 set MCB OVERLAP 0 set MCB T0 0 set MCB LOCKT0 0 XML MCB # modulation C off set MCC FRQ 0 set MCC ADJ 1 set MCC T0 0 set MCC LOCKT0 0 XML MCC # PSC1 off set PSC1 FRQ 0.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0:1 set PSC1 T0 0 set PSC1 LOCKT0 0 set PSC1 ADJ 1 XML PSC1 # PSC2 off set PSC2 FRQ 0.0 set PSC2 TIMING 0:1 set PSC2 T0 0 set PSC2 LOCKT0 0 set PSC2 ADJ 1 XML PSC2 # PSC3 off set PSC3 FRQ 0.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0:1 set PSC3 T0 0 set PSC3 LOCKT0 0 set PSC3 ADJ 1 XML PSC3 # Open slits and put GEX1 on by default set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM F0 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE F0_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#--------------------------------------------------- # mode F1: maximum beam with FC2A@14 Hz, phase=-0.8, with overlaps #---------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 4.2 XML UPDATE # FC2A on set FC2A ADJ 0 set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A PHASE -0.8 set FC2A OVERLAP 1 XML FC2A set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM F1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE F1_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#--------------------------------------------------- # mode F2: maximum beam with FC2A@14 Hz, phase=-0.8, with overlaps, beam 1x2 cm #---------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 4.2 XML UPDATE # FC2A on set FC2A ADJ 0 set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A PHASE -0.8 set FC2A OVERLAP 1 XML FC2A set SL3 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 20.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM F2 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE F2_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 1, PS0, Maximum intensity, pulse shaping, diffraction, max. slit, 10.0, 20.0, 25.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 1, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0:1 XML FC1A
# FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC3 FRQ -168.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC3 T0 1 set PSC3 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC3 set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 20.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM PS0 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS0_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 2, PS1, High flux, pulse shaping, in-situ thermo mechanical experiment, 5.0, 10.0, 25.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 1, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC3 FRQ -168.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC3 T0 1 set PSC3 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC3 set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 5.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM PS1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS1_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 3, PS2, Medium resolution, pulse shaping, in-situ thermo mechanical experiment, 5.0, 10.0, 23.0, 0.0, 35.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 2, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC2 FRQ -168.0 set PSC2 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC2 T0 1 set PSC2 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC2 set GCA3 DIST 277 XML GCA3 set GCB DIST 87 XML GCB set SL1 SIZE(1) 35.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 23.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 5.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM PS2 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS2_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 4, PS3, High resolution, pulse shaping, in-situ thermo mechanical experiment, 5.0, 10.0, 15.0, 0.0, 20.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 3, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC2 FRQ -168.0 set PSC2 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC2 T0 1 set PSC2 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC2 set GCA3 DIST 77 XML GCA3 set GCB DIST 287 XML GCB set SL1 SIZE(1) 20.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 15.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 5.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM PS3 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS3_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 5, M0, Maximum intensity, modulation, diffraction, max. slit, 10.0, 20.0, 25.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 4, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set MCA FRQ 70.0 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCA T0 1 set MCA LOCKT0 0 XML MCA set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 20.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM M0 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE M0_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 6, M1, High flux, modulation, strain scanning, 2.0, 5.0, 25.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 4, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set MCA FRQ 70.0 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCA T0 1 set MCA LOCKT0 0 XML MCA set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 2.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 5.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM M1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE M1_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 7, M2, Medium resolution, modulation, strain scanning, 1.0, 3.0, 15.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2.10, 4, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set MCA FRQ 140.0 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCA T0 1 set MCA LOCKT0 0 XML MCA set SL1 SIZE(1) 35.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 18.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 1.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 3.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM M2 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE M2_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 8, M3, High resolution, modulation, strain scanning, 1.0, 3.0, 8.0, 50.0, 12.0, 0.0, 0, 2.10, 5, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A
# FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set MCA FRQ 280.0 set MCA OVERLAP 1 set MCA T0 1 set MCA LOCKT0 0 XML MCA set SL1 SIZE(1) 18.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 12.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 50.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 1.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 3.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM M3 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE M3_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE

# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set SL1 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 25.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM IM0 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE IM0_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 10, IM1, High flux, pulse shaping, imaging, Bragg edge, 0.0, 0.0, 25.0, 25.0, 10.0, 10.0, 0, 3.50, 1, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 3.5 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC3 FRQ -168.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC3 T0 1 set PSC3 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC3 set SL1 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 25.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM IM1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE IM1_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 11, SANS, White beam, SANS, 10.0, 10.0, 15.0, 15.0, 20.0, 20.0, 0, 6.00, 0, 1 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 6.0 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 set FC1A OVERLAP 1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 set FC2A OVERLAP 1 XML FC2A
set SL1 SIZE(1) 20.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 20.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 15.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 15.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 10.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM SANS mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE SANS_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
#----------------------------------------------------------------------- # 12, DS0, diffraction + SANS, modulation, in-situ thermomechanical experiment, 5.0, 10.0, 25.0, 25.0, 40.0, 40.0, 0, 2.10, 6, 3 #----------------------------------------------------------------------- set INST LAMBDA 4.35 XML UPDATE
set FC1A ADJ 1 set FC2A ADJ 1 # FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 14.0 set FC1A TIMING 0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 7.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A set FC1A ADJ 0 set FC2A ADJ 0
set INST LAMBDA 5.7 XML UPDATE set MCC FRQ 70.0 set MCC T0 1 XML MCC
set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 40.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 25.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 5.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
cmd BEAM1D COM DS0 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE DS0_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE

set SOURCE LAMW 2 XML SOURCE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 14.0 set FC1A TIMING 0.0:1 XML FC1A # FC1B on set FC1B FRQ 63.0 set FC1B TIMING 0:1 XML FC1B # FC2B on set FC2B FRQ 7.0 set FC2B TIMING 0:1 XML FC2B
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC3 FRQ -168.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC3 T0 1 set PSC3 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC3
# set choppers phase to the shorter wavelength and fix phase set FC1B ADJ 1 set PSC1 ADJ 1 set PSC3 ADJ 1 set FC2B ADJ 1 set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE set FC1B ADJ 0 set PSC1 ADJ 0 set PSC3 ADJ 0 set FC2B ADJ 0
# set FC1A phase to lambda + 1x bandwidth and fix phase set FC1A ADJ 1 set INST LAMBDA 3.8884 XML UPDATE set FC1A ADJ 0
set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 40.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 25.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 25.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 0 0 0 0 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 5.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 10.0 XML SL3
# simulate the 1st frame set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
cmd BEAM1D COM DS1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE DS1_lam_1.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
# shift phases of FC1B and FC2B by one source period set FC1B TIMING 4.5:1 XML FC1B set FC2B TIMING 0.5:1 XML FC2B
# simulate the 2nd frame set INST LAMBDA 5.6769 XML UPDATE
cmd BEAM1D COM DS1 mode DO MC DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE DS1_lam_2.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
# reset default set FC1B TIMING 0:1 XML FC1B set FC2B TIMING 0:1 XML FC2B set FC1B ADJ 1 set PSC1 ADJ 1 set PSC3 ADJ 1 set FC2B ADJ 1
#---------------------------------------------------------------------- # Cross-validation with McStas: # PS0 modes with open slit 3, zero waviness and misalignment #-----------------------------------------------------------------------
set INST LAMBDA 2.1 XML UPDATE
# FC1A on set FC1A FRQ 28.0 set FC1A TIMING 0:1 XML FC1A # FC2A on set FC2A FRQ 14.0 set FC2A TIMING 0:1 XML FC2A
set PSC1 FRQ 168.0 set PSC1 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC1 T0 1 set PSC1 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC1 set PSC3 FRQ -168.0 set PSC3 TIMING 0.2:1 set PSC3 T0 1 set PSC3 LOCKT0 1 XML PSC3 set SL1 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL1 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL1 set SL2 SIZE(1) 40.0 set SL2 SIZE(2) 80.0 XML SL2 set GEX1 ACTIVE 1 1 1 1 XML GEX1 set SL3 SIZE(1) 100.0 set SL3 SIZE(2) 100.0 XML SL3
set NBOA MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set BBG MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GSW MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCA1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCA2 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCA3 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCA4 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCB MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCC MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCE MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCF MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GCG MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GE1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GN1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GN2 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GSH2 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GE2A MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GE2B MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GT1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GT2 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GF1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GF2 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0 set GEX1 MISALIGN 0.0 0.0
set NBOA WAV 0.0 set BBG WAV 0.0 set GSW WAV 0.0 set GCA1 WAV 0.0 set GCA2 WAV 0.0 set GCA3 WAV 0.0 set GCA4 WAV 0.0 set GCB WAV 0.0 set GCC WAV 0.0 set GCE WAV 0.0 set GCF WAV 0.0 set GCG WAV 0.0 set GE1 WAV 0.0 set GN1 WAV 0.0 set GN2 WAV 0.0 set GSH2 WAV 0.0 set GE2A WAV 0.0 set GE2B WAV 0.0 set GT1 WAV 0.0 set GT2 WAV 0.0 set GF1 WAV 0.0 set GF2 WAV 0.0 set GEX1 WAV 0.0
set TR CNT 1000000 set TR DIR 0 DO MC
# autoscale cmd BEAM1D XAUTO 1
cmd BEAM1D COM PS0, validation, zero waviness and misalignment cmd BEAM1D X 8 DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS0_val_lam.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
cmd BEAM1D X 6 DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS0_val_t.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
cmd BEAM1D X 3 DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS0_val_kx.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
cmd BEAM1D X 4 DO BEAM1D cmd GRSAVE FILE PS0_val_ky.dat cmd GRSAVE OVER no do GRSAVE
